correctness.rationale: Full optimum and unique Lagrange multiplier are exact by cube duality. Hyperplane feasibility reduces exactly to a one-dimensional interval. Both perturbation envelopes follow from attained coordinatewise and Euclidean norm extrema. Independent Gaussian errors reduce to a folded-normal sum; the strong law and the central limit theorem yield the almost-sure limit and normal critical window. The standalone checker passed 623 rational LP, 3050 extremal and 14400 seeded Gaussian checks; infinite conclusions rely on the proof, not testing.

value.rationale: For the actual weighted aggregation mechanism of the new column-generation proposal, this family exhibits exactly how ideal multiplier recovery loses useful bound guarantees when weights are perturbed. It gives a sharp deterministic precision budget and a dimension-scaled stochastic complete-loss phase, isolating the importance of weight accuracy from any putative failure of the iterative update procedure. Normalization and applicability limits are explicit.
